teaser: A song comes on in a crowded kitchen at a party and you're the first one dancing, plate still in hand — that's the ESFP showing early, and underneath it runs the 1, the number of the one who starts things. The 1 asks for a life built around your own direction; the ESFP asks for a life built around the room. What's particular here is a leader who leads by lighting the room up rather than by standing apart from it. You pull people toward an idea by making it fun first, true second. That's rare, and it has its own cost: the room can start running you instead of the other way around.
excerpt: Who stays after the applause — the real question this number and type put to anyone close to you.
